newsitem.title: USA: Lucent, Philips form consumer products company.
newsitem.headline: Lucent, Philips form consumer products company.

text.p: Telecommnications company Lucent Technologies Inc. and electronics giant Philips Electronics NV on Tuesday said they agreed to merge their consumer communications products businesses into a jointly owned company valued at $2.5 billion.

The company, called Philips Consumer Communications, will provide corded and cordless phones and answering machines, and develop, manufacture and market a line of products including digital and analogue cellular phones, screen phones, and pagers.

Philips will own 60 percent of the venture and Lucent will own 40 percent of the newly formed company. The merger should be complete by October 1. The breakdown represents the relative revenue contributions of the two companies to the business, a Lucent spokeswoman said

In a prepared statement, the companies said they expect "the vast majority" of the 8,400 Lucent and the 4,000 Philips employees currently in their consumer telephony businesses will move to the new venture.
Philips Consumer Communications, which will be located in New Jersey, plans to deliver more than 40 products by the holiday season, including a long range cordless phone.

Michael McTighe, managing director of Philips Consumer Communications, will become chief executive of the new company. In a statement, McTighe said that both Lucent and Philips will move ahead with current product commitments to retailers and service providers.
